eras.title: The Cradle of Echoes & Kubrart Eclipse
eras.narrative_arc: Awakening of the 3x3 Citadel of Echoes, discovery of the Kubrart negative-space astral prisms, integration of the 24fps Studio PxG Hyper-Striker arena league, and the cataclysmic Sovereign Law Tribunal siege against the Abyssal Echo Swarm.
eras.morphological_art_direction: Stylized 6.5-to-7.5-head proportions, tapered gauntlets/boots, pen-and-ink G-pen crosshatching over warm parchment-gold filigree, stark negative-space sumi-ink blocks, vibrant watercolor cel-wash, and 24fps kagenashi key-animation rim lighting.

eras.title: The Sovereign Mechanica & Chrono-Lattice War
eras.narrative_arc: Ascension of 7.5-head cyber-magicite mecha frames and pilot-link conduits across the fractured Chrono-Lattice, high-altitude Valkyrie sky armadas, bushido sumi-ink counter-parries, and colossal 2-cell Void Leviathan raids culminating in the Lattice Collapse.
eras.morphological_art_direction: 7.5-head orthographic cyber-magicite mecha geometry, sleek beveled armor edges, translucent astral energy wings, 14mm fisheye perspective foreshortening, CMYK halftone screentone dot-matrix, and dense monochrome G-pen bushido ink crosshatching.

eras.title: The Astral Singularity & Omega Convergence
eras.narrative_arc: Emergence of Transcendent Rank-A (10) Ascended Conduits, Genie-4 dynamic player-forged biome tiles, the cross-era Echo Multiverse Tournament, and the 10th Anniversary Omega Convergence uniting all four factions in the Eternal Cradle Apex.
eras.morphological_art_direction: Chiaroscuro obsidian-ivory tarot monolith iconography, concentric gilded astrolabe halos, polyhedral pastel-neon pyro/cryo sakuga plumes, 2-frame binary woodcut impact stencils, and prismatic collector-vault holographic foil relief.

Standard_Rotation.rotation_cadence: Every H1 release (annually in Year 3+), the oldest 2 sets rotate into Eternal Unlimited while granting 100% Wildcard/Echo-Dust Sovereign Heritage rebates for cosmetics.

Eternal_Format.balance_valve: Sovereign Law Tribunal dynamic Point-Buy & 1-of Restricted Decree list updated quarterly via V100 MCTS telemetry.

Arena_Draft.format_name: Hyperdome Cube Draft (5-Round 117+ Card Curated Cube)

power_creep_governor.philosophy: Strict invariant directional stat ceiling across all 10 years (20 sets). New expansions introduce orthogonal tactical movement, terrain interaction, and conditional synergies rather than raw N/E/S/W stat inflation, guaranteeing Year 1 cards remain tournament-viable in Year 10.

hard_invariants.rank_10_restriction: At most 1 directional side may hold Rank 10 (A), requiring Cost 4 and a directional vulnerability (<= 6) on the opposite compass edge.

ethical_monetization_model.model_name: Studio PxG Sovereign Fair-Play & High-Craft Cosmetic Economy
ethical_monetization_model.card_acquisition_guarantee: 100% of gameplay cards in every 120-card set are earnable within 18 hours of seasonal play or instant 1:1 deterministic Wildcard crafting with zero duplicate-protection traps.
